EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The capsule's mixed in to the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}letter{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
section of your stuff, so go bury it
and come back.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Don't tell anyone!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}And don't open it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} duh!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hala, llevas la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}entre tus
cartas. Entiérrala y pásate a verme.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Que no te vea nadie.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ¡Y sobre
todo{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} no la abras!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule temporelle{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} se trouve
dans ton {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}courrier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, file donc
l'enterrer !
Et euh, ne l'ouvre pas, d'accord ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La tua capsula si trova dove tieni
le tue {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lettere{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Corri a sotterrarla!
E ricorda, acqua in bocca!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}E non ti azzardare ad aprirla!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die Zeitkapsel findest du bei
deinen {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Briefen{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Jetzt vergrab sie
und komm dann zurück!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Und erzähl ja niemandem davon!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:000A:}}Und denk nicht mal dran, sie zu
öffnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kapsül eşyalarındaki {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mektup{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
bölümüne karıştı; git göm de
dön.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Kimseye söyleme!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bir de açma,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tabii ki!

EN:
OK, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I'm counting on you with that
time capsule!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} And don't forget,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}it's
mixed in with your {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}letters{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Oh, and don't open it!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} It's private!
ES:
De acuerdo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}cuento contigo para
enterrar la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}del tiempo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}No olvides que está entre tus cartas{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}y sobre todo:{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}} ¡no seas cotilla y no
la abras!
FR:
Je compte sur toi pour la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}capsule{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Elle doit se trouver avec toutes tes
lettres.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Et surtout ne l'ouvre pas ! C'est
privé !
IT:
OK, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dacci dentro con quella capsula!
Ricorda che l'ho messa dove tieni
le tue {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lettere{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ah! E non aprirla! È privata!
DE:
Hör zu, ich vertrau dir mit der
Zeitkapsel, klar? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du findest sie bei
deinen {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Briefen{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Aber mach sie bloß nicht auf!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The capsule is with the rest of your
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}letters{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Do a good job burying it!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}And don't forget where you put it!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}And by the way, if you open it, {{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'll
make you sorry!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} So don't open it!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Recuerda que la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cápsula {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}está con
tus cartas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Por cierto, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}no te olvides de dónde
la entierras.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Y ni se te ocurra 
abrirla, ¿eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Cuento contigo!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho messo la capsula dove tieni
le tue {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lettere{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Sotterrala bene!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
E memorizza dove l'hai messa!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A proposito... {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Se la apri, saranno
guai! Quindi non provarci nemmeno!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Die Zeitkapsel ist bei deinen
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Briefen{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Vergrab sie schön, aber
vergiss nicht, wo!
Ach ja, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}wenn du sie aufmachst...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0007:}}Dann kriegen wir beide
Ärger miteinander!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kapsül diğer {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}mektuplarının{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} arasında.
Güzelce göm!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0002:}}Nereye koyduğunu da unutma!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ha, açarsan {{TAG:0003:0006:}}pişman ederim!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Sakın açma!
